scope.frozen_query: SELECT id,source_key,record,audit FROM heads WHERE baseline=0 AND experimental=1 ORDER BY id
scope.id_freeze: Exact immutable catalog hash and predicate bind the set before execution; metadata writes every ID/record/audit hash before occurrences.

stage_admission: Metadata executes only after root code review. Occurrences additionally needs occurrence-approval.json authorized=true, protocol_sha256 and exact metadata_receipt_sha256 after root checks measured joins/volume. Failure retained; no automatic retry/quota change.

evidence_math.wholephrase_variants: Count retained target keys/variant IDs before any noun interpretation.
evidence_math.occurrence: Stream all retained observations with exact40000 full pairs and forward/reverse alignment. Source focus offsets are the frozen catalog offsets within matching source context.
evidence_math.lexical_span: Union-linked target token extent, contiguous, within recorded variant target span, mutual anchor, no crossing. Target span >5 tokens is separately unsupported by frozen dictionary-unit bound.
evidence_math.dictionary: Read unchanged dictionary-unit helper on exact source/target focus tokens using original whole text/capitalization. Require complete supported noun forms, number agreement and explicit/eligible shared term; only source exact name-only guard may be ignored as already frozen. No target guard removal.
evidence_math.identities: Target lexeme+form+actual occurrence spelling+reading retained separately; linked sense IDs recorded, not treated as source occurrence labels or truth.
evidence_math.independence: Pair IDs, components, paired(pair ID,source focus tokens) and distinct source(endpoint ID,fingerprint,record SHA,source focus tokens) counted separately. Source-window features counted once per distinct source endpoint occurrence and target identity; multiple Spanish translations and phrase expansions do not multiply source-context observations.
evidence_math.census: All1480 IDs, all retained variants and all supported identity alternatives; no defaultwinner/ranking/fitting. All29 added emissions retain detailed occurrence links, source/target units and fullpair evidence.
evidence_math.size: All metadata uses an8MiB combined hard cap with receipt reserve; prospective whole encoded file checks. No silent alternative truncation; uncertain dictionary/proof volume is explicit.
evidence_math.join_integrity: Every selected observation must match full pair ID/index and both endpoint components, exact source/target token bounds, codepoint/UTF16 geometry and normalized source/target frozen variant spelling. Every variant seen count must equal its retained count; global equality alone is insufficient.
evidence_math.compact_retention: Census independent identity sets are represented by exact count and sorted-set SHA; variant IDs and every alternative remain. Detailed29-emission evidence retains every occurrence reference, full pair/token/alignment, and all unit/form/link records through deduplicated content-addressed references. No silent truncation.

name_diagnostic.scope: Separate existing source masks/complete-unit guards, protected ranges, native words, all intersecting source context windows and recorded candidates. No new NER/protection rule.

interpretation: Shared linked dictionary sense is not semantic gold or complete source sense coverage.
Corpus occurrence POS/sense annotations are absent; preserve dictionary labels and native review role evidence without conflation.
Whole-sentence compound/literal/current-role eligibility is not regenerated; supported noun links are availability evidence, not admitted runtime candidates.
An identical target spelling can have multiple meanings/lexemes; one lexeme can have multiple forms.
Counts compare alternatives and source features; no learned rule, target rerank, projection or accuracy claim.
Named-title span protection remains distinct from noun lexical selection.
proposed_mechanism: If the census supplies multiple supported target identities with independent component witnesses and distinguishable source-context counts, prepare an offline Apertium-style ambiguous lexical inventory and weighted context rules choosing target forms rather than all fine-grained senses. Keep default-frequency control, component-held-out evaluation and explicit abstention for unsupported cases; no training authorized here. If alternatives are missing, repair evidence collection before classifier work.
